description_en: Deletes instance labels from ARMS resources
description_zh: 用于删除ARMS资源实例标签
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The list of tag keys to delete. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If this parameter is not specified, you can set the All parameter to delete all tags
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的标签键列表，不超过20个。不填可通过All参数删除所有标签
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en: The PID or instance ID of the application. You can specify up to 50 IDs
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ARMS resource type for which you want to modify tags. Valid values: 

WEB: Browser Monitoring 
APPLICATION: Application Monitoring 
PROMETHEUS: Managed Service for Prometheus 
SYNTHETICTASK: Synthetic Monitoring 
ALERTRULE: Application Monitoring alerts 
PROMETHEUSALERTRULE: Managed Service for Prometheus alerts
XTRACEAPP: Tracing Analysis OpenTelemetry Edition application
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改标签的ARMS资源类型。 

WEB-前端监控 
APPLICATION-应用监控 
PROMETHEUS-可观测监控 Prometheus 版 
SYNTHETICTASK-云拨测 
ALERTRULE-应用监控告警 
PROMETHEUSALERTRULE-可观测监控 Prometheus 版告警
XTRACEAPP - 可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版应用
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is left empty. Valid values:

true: Deletes all tags.
false: Does not delete all tags. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否全部删除，只针对TagKey.N为空时有效。取值范围：

true：全部删除
false（默认）：不全部删除
parameters.name: all

fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或 `https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance.

If this parameter is specified, it can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。

如果传入该值，则允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag key-value pairs. This parameter is required when the ResourceIds parameter is not specified. Description:                              

key: The tag key. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.                                 
value: The tag value. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length. 
                                
Tag keys and values are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, they are created and bound to the specified resources simultaneously. A tag key on a resource can correspond to only one tag value. If you add a tag with an existing key, the corresponding tag value is updated to the new value. The key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：                              

key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。                                 
value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。 
                                
区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tags

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the tags were deleted successfully
